Seer.directive_trigger: players pivot aggressively to attack silent players
Seer.directive_rationale: scrutinize those who pivot most aggressively to attack silent players
Seer.verdict_notes: No players aggressively pivoted to attack silent players; the debate centered on Jin's demands for claims and later on behavior/mirroring.

Guard.directive_rationale: Do not treat silence as a definitive wolf signal
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard (Jin) did not disregard silence; instead, he explicitly stated in Round 1 that 'Refusal to claim is a signal of guilt,' which is the opposite of the directive, but the trigger (a specific silent player during the vote phase) did not occur in a way that required a decision on silence as a signal.

Guard.directive_trigger: choosing between timing of claims and factual contradictions
Guard.verdict_notes: Jin did not face a choice between timing of claims and factual contradictions; he focused on the timing/refusal of claims as a signal of guilt.

Witch.directive_trigger: player has not provided a contradictory signal AND seer_is_active == True
Witch.directive_rationale: Never poison a player who has not provided a contradictory signal, especially when the Seer is still active
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Hoang (Witch) did not use any potions during the night of Round 2.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer was active at the start of the night, and Hoang withheld the poison potion.

Villager.directive_rationale: claim your role early to remove yourself as an easy target
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan (Villager) did not claim their role in Round 1; they focused on supporting Nam the Seer and attacking Jin. Cong (Villager) did not claim their role in Round 1.
Villager.verdict_notes: Neither Villager claimed their role at the start of the game.

Villager.directive_trigger: players use 'urgency' to force a rush vote without evidence
Villager.directive_rationale: be wary of players who use 'urgency' to force a rush vote without evidence
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nhan and Cong both voted for Jin, explicitly citing in their voting reasons that Jin used urgency and pressure tactics to force a rush vote.
Villager.verdict_notes: Both Villagers identified and challenged the rush vote tactics used by Jin.
